plain: John Blitch, a scientist who once worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, and who says he was abducted by an alien, told podcast host Jesse Michels how the military handles witnesses. He says people who saw something together, such as Terry and Toby, or Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, were split up and reassigned so they could not talk to each other. If true, it would mean witnesses are deliberately kept apart.
